title: The Lord Calls Samuel
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and listens to find out what something could be, and tonight Samuel keeps asking who is calling until he learns it is the Lord: Scout goes quiet in the backyard and hears what the loud day was hiding.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Samuel had to look and listen to find out who was calling, and finding out is Scout’s favorite thing. In Scout’s world today: the backyard is full of noise, a lawn mower, a barking dog, and his sister singing. Scout lies down in the grass and gets very, very still. Little by little he hears new things: a bird, the wind in the leaves, a tiny cricket right by his ear. “They were here the whole time!” he whispers. Just like Samuel at the temple, Scout learned that the quiet voices are the easiest to miss and the best to hear.
